name: Harjit Sandhu
quote: Our store opens clean every morning. The overnight crew scrubs the floors, cleans the washrooms and the entrance, and works around our late deliveries. We never have to chase anything.

name: Amit Sharma
quote: The cleaning crew did an amazing job on our office. Efficient and eco-friendly, our workspace has never looked better. Team morale is up. Highly recommend!

name: Sarah Lindstrom
quote: We manage several retail locations and wanted one cleaning standard across all of them. They set up a clear checklist for each store and answer straight away on WhatsApp.

name: Dave Kowalchuk
quote: Working with Jamal Cleaning Services has been a real pleasure and a real experience. It doesn’t feel like an outside operation – the team work as one. It’s been comforting to know that when you have your back to the wall, as you do with a project this size, Jamal Cleaning Services are standing there beside us not walking away… they are a true partner.

name: Chris Pedersen
quote: Our team walks into a clean, fresh office every morning and never has to think about it. The crew is reliable and easy to work with. Highly recommend them to any business.

name: Mike Thompson
quote: Overnight cleaning is exactly what we needed. We open to a spotless kitchen and dining room, and the crew works around our schedule without any fuss.

name: Manpreet Dhaliwal
quote: Cleanliness matters a great deal in our clinic. The team is detail-oriented, punctual and always leaves our rooms spotless and fresh.

name: Karen MacDonald
quote: I always look forward to welcoming the Jamal Cleaning team into my home. I get to relax and enjoy the morning, and before I know it, my entire home is clean and sparkly from top to bottom. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

name: Priya Nair
quote: We recently moved to the area and are very happy that we chose Jamal Cleaning Services. They do an excellent job every time. They provide their arrival time and are always punctual. It is also important to us that they use environmentally friendly cleaning products.

name: Gurpreet Grewal
quote: Between tenants we need units cleaned quickly and properly. Jamal Cleaning Services turns them around to a high standard, which makes every turnover easier for us.

name: Ryan Fraser
quote: After our renovation there was dust on everything. The post-construction clean was thorough, and the house felt like new again.

name: Simran Brar
quote: I booked a deep clean before hosting family for the holidays and the house looked better than the day we moved in. Friendly, careful and respectful of our home.

name: Lisa Bouchard
quote: The move-out clean was thorough, right down to the inside of the cabinets and appliances. I now book them whenever a unit becomes free.

name: Brenda Olson
quote: If it wasn’t for Jamal Cleaning Services, I don’t think I could live in my home. Every month, the efficient, friendly crew shows up and does a thorough cleaning. When they are done, everything looks brand-new, beautiful, everything smells good, and I am so happy to have found this great service.

name: Pooja Mehta
quote: As a busy parent, this cleaning service is a lifesaver! Thorough, friendly, and trustworthy. Coming home to a spotless house is such a relief. Highly recommend!
